TfrmMain.Create.text: Creates the main window by loading the designed form (menus, status bar, file dialogs) from mainform.lfm; the run-time setup is done in FormCreate.

TfrmMain.Destroy.text: Frees the property editors, detaches the view from the design and frees the design. Safe if construction failed part way.

TfrmMain.BuildLayout.text: Creates the run-time controls: ribbon page control, status bar, sheet tabs, symbol library panel, splitter and the drawing view, and connects their events.

TfrmMain.AddButton.text: Adds a ribbon button to a tab at the position X and moves X along for the next one.

TfrmMain.AddToolButton.text: Adds a ribbon button that selects a drawing tool; it joins the group of tool buttons so one stays pressed, and its Tag holds the tool number.

TfrmMain.Gap.text: Leaves a small gap between groups of ribbon buttons.

TfrmMain.BuildRibbon.text: Fills the ribbon: Home (undo, redo, snap, grid size, select, delete), Draw, Ladder, Library and View buttons, the grid-size menu, and the Properties tab's scrolling editor area.

TfrmMain.UpdateRibbonState.text: Brings ribbon buttons in line with the program: undo / redo enabled and their hints, snap toggle, grid size caption, and which tool button is pressed.

TfrmMain.ClearPropEditors.text: Removes all property editors from the Properties tab.

TfrmMain.RebuildProps.text: Rebuilds the Properties tab for the current selection: one editor per property the selected objects share (text box, drop-down, check box or color swatch), two per column, then fills in their values.

TfrmMain.CommitProp.text: Applies a value typed or chosen in a property editor to all selected objects as one undo step, then refreshes the editors and the status line.

TfrmMain.PropEditDone.text: Event handler: a text editor lost focus or Enter was pressed, so apply its text (an untouched "mixed" field is left alone).

TfrmMain.PropChoiceChange.text: Event handler: a drop-down choice changed, so apply it.

TfrmMain.PropBoolClick.text: Event handler: a check box was clicked, so apply 1 or 0.

TfrmMain.PropColorClick.text: Event handler: a color swatch was clicked, so ask for a color and apply it.

TfrmMain.SetPropertyText.text: Sets a property through the same path as typing it into its editor (used by the self-test script).
TfrmMain.SetPropertyText.returns: False if the selection has no such property

TfrmMain.PropertyDump.text: Lists the properties on the ribbon with their values, "(mixed)" where selected objects differ; for tests.

TfrmMain.ShowRibbonTab.text: Brings a ribbon tab forward by its caption.

TfrmMain.RibbonTabTitle.text: Caption of the ribbon tab showing now.

TfrmMain.PressRibbon.text: Presses a ribbon button found by its caption, as if clicked (used by the self-test script).
TfrmMain.PressRibbon.returns: False if no button has that caption

TfrmMain.SetGridMmFromScript.text: Sets the grid size and updates the ribbon (used by the self-test script).

TfrmMain.SetDesign.text: Makes a design the current document: detaches the old one, shows the new in the view, and refreshes sheet tabs, caption, paper status, ribbon and properties.

TfrmMain.RebuildSheetTabs.text: Rebuilds the sheet tabs from the sheet names (or "Sheet N").

TfrmMain.UpdateCaption.text: Sets the window title from the file name, a * when modified, and the application name.

TfrmMain.UpdatePaperStatus.text: Shows the current sheet's paper size in the status bar.

TfrmMain.ConfirmDiscard.text: Asks whether to save changes before discarding the document.

TfrmMain.OpenDesignFile.text: Loads a .dsn file, gives every object an id, and makes it the current document. Errors are raised.

TfrmMain.NewDesignWith.text: Creates a new document with a paper size without showing the dialog (used by scripts).

TfrmMain.OpenLibraryFile.text: Opens a symbol library in the library panel.

TfrmMain.InsertLadderMm.text: Adds a ladder to the current sheet from a rectangle given in millimetres, as one undo step.
TfrmMain.InsertLadderMm.returns: the new ladder, or nil if no document is open

TfrmMain.PlaceLibraryRow.text: Selects a library row and places the symbol with a click at a position (used by scripts).

TfrmMain.DoNew.text: Menu handler: asks to save changes, shows the New Document dialog and opens a new document from it.

TfrmMain.DoOpen.text: Menu handler: asks to save changes, then lets the user pick a .dsn file and opens it.

TfrmMain.DoSave.text: Menu handler: saves to the current file, or asks for a name if untitled.

TfrmMain.DoSaveAs.text: Menu handler: asks for a file name and saves there.

TfrmMain.DoOpenLibrary.text: Menu handler: lets the user pick a .TCLib library and opens it in the library panel.

TfrmMain.DoFileExit.text: Menu handler: closes the window (asking about unsaved changes).

TfrmMain.DoDelete.text: Menu handler: deletes the selected objects.

TfrmMain.DoSelectAll.text: Menu handler: selects everything on the sheet.

TfrmMain.DoRedo.text: Handler: redoes the last undone action.

TfrmMain.DoToolButton.text: Ribbon handler: starts the drawing tool whose number is in the button's Tag (or returns to select).

TfrmMain.DoPlaceSymbol.text: Handler: starts placing the symbol selected in the library panel, opening a library first if none is open.

TfrmMain.DoAddSheet.text: Handler: adds a sheet with the same paper, border, title block and grid as the current one, as one undo step, and shows it.

TfrmMain.DoProperties.text: Menu handler: properties are on the ribbon now, so bring the Properties tab forward.

TfrmMain.DoInsertLadder.text: Menu handler: starts the ladder rails tool.

TfrmMain.DoRemoveSheet.text: Menu handler: removing a sheet is not implemented yet, so it says so.

TfrmMain.DoToggleGrid.text: Handler: shows or hides the grid dots and ticks the menu item.

TfrmMain.DoToggleSnap.text: Ribbon handler: turns snapping to the grid on or off.

TfrmMain.DoGridButton.text: Ribbon handler: pops up the grid-size menu under the button with the current size ticked.

TfrmMain.DoGridSize.text: Grid-size menu handler: applies the size held in the menu item's Tag (hundredths of a millimetre).

TfrmMain.DoGridCustom.text: Grid-size menu handler: asks for a custom grid size in millimetres (0.05 to 100).

TfrmMain.DescribeSelection.text: A short description of the selection for the status bar and ribbon (the kind of object, or "N objects").
TfrmMain.DescribeSelection.returns: the description, empty when nothing is selected

TfrmMain.ViewSelection.text: View event: the selection changed. Updates the status bar, rebuilds the property editors, and brings the Properties tab forward when the select tool is active.

TfrmMain.ViewStatus.text: View event: shows a message in the first status panel.

TfrmMain.ViewModified.text: View event: the design changed. Marks it modified, updates the caption, and refreshes the property values.

TfrmMain.ViewToolChanged.text: View event: the active tool changed, so refresh the pressed tool button.

TfrmMain.ViewUndoChanged.text: View event: undo state changed, so refresh the undo / redo buttons.

TfrmMain.ViewPlaced.text: View event: an object was created. One-shot tools return to select; a new label brings the Properties tab forward and focuses its text box.

TfrmMain.SheetTabChange.text: Event handler: another sheet tab was chosen, so show that sheet.

TfrmMain.LibPlace.text: Library panel event: starts placing the chosen symbol on the current sheet.

TfrmMain.FormCloseQuery.text: Event handler: allows closing only after unsaved changes have been dealt with.

params.CanClose: set False to cancel the close

TfrmMain.UpdateFormTitle.text: Sets the window title: "Schematic - [file name]" (Untitled for an unsaved document, a * when modified), or just the application name when no document is open. A non-empty NewTitle is shown as given.

params.NewTitle: text to show instead of the file name; empty to work it out from the document

TfrmMain.FormCreate.text: OnCreate handler: sets the caption, makes the window big enough for the ribbon if the designed size is smaller, then builds the run-time controls (layout and ribbon) and starts with no document.

TfrmMain.FormResize.text: OnResize handler: gives the three status-bar panels their share of the window width (StatusBarScale in consts).

TfrmNewDoc.FormCreate.text: OnCreate handler: fills the family list ("All sizes" first, then each paper family), resets the title-block fields and the 6.35 mm border margin, lists the papers and selects ISO A4 landscape.

TfrmNewDoc.PaperChange.text: Event handler: shows the selected paper's name and its page size in internal units (0.2 mm each).

params.Sender: the paper list or the orientation group

TfrmNewDoc.FillPapers.text: Fills the size list with the papers of the chosen family ("All sizes" shows every paper) and selects the first.

TfrmNewDoc.SelectPaper.text: Selects a paper and orientation in the dialog (used for defaults and by scripts); the family is reset to "All sizes" so every paper can be found.

params.AName: paper name from the paper table
params.ALandscape: True for landscape, False for portrait

TfrmNewDoc.BuildDesign.text: Creates the new design from the dialog's choices: one sheet with the chosen paper size and orientation, the title-block text, automatic sheet numbers and border (with its margin) as ticked, and a first revision "A - Initial issue".
TfrmNewDoc.BuildDesign.returns: the new design; the caller owns it

TfrmNewDoc.PaperIndex.text: The paper table index of the selected size (ISO A4 when nothing is selected).

TfrmNewDoc.Landscape.returns: True for landscape, False for portrait

TfrmNewDoc.FamilyChange.text: Event handler: the paper family changed, so refill the size list.
